title: arenaria groenlandica var. glabra
intro: Arenaria groenlandica var. glabra, commonly known as Greenland sandwort, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, supporting the immune system, and possibly reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Greenland sandwort include its ability to modulate the immune response, exhibit antioxidant activity, and potentially influence the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Greenland sandwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and composition.
